subject: Recap + next steps — technical deep-dive options
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Emma Lawson <emma.lawson@finovate.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + next steps — technical deep-dive options

Hi Emma —

Thanks again for the time today — great conversation. Quick recap from our discovery:
- Main goal: reduce inference latency for your search ranking pipeline and cut per-request cost by ~30% without changing model outputs.
- Primary constraints: must stay within Finovate's VPC and integrate with existing KMS; retention and audit logs required for regulatory review.
- Next step we agreed: a 30‑minute technical deep-dive with engineering (demo + infra Q&A).

Proposed tight slots next week (30 minutes):
• Tue 27 Apr, 10:00–10:30 AM PT — calendar: https://cal.redwood.com/s/27Apr-slotA
• Wed 28 Apr, 03:00–03:30 PM PT — calendar: https://cal.redwood.com/s/28Apr-slotB

Marissa (cc'd) would lead the demo and will cover deployment options (Dedicated vs Private) and the KV caching behavior that mattered in your latency profile. If neither works, please suggest two windows and we'll do our best.

I attached a short one‑pager with the discovery notes and the checklist we discussed. Please confirm a slot within 48 hours so we can lock an engineer.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555‑0132
Attachment: discovery-notes.pdf
From: Emma Lawson <emma.lawson@finovate.com>

Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 11:02:13 -0400
Subject: Re: Recap + next steps — technical deep-dive options

Hi Rafael (and Marissa),

Sorry — we had an internal issue this morning and I missed the first call. Appreciate the recap.

Quick note on availability: the week of Apr 27 is pretty tight for our platform team. Could we look at May 3–5, mornings ET (8–11 AM ET)? Also, I'd like our lead platform engineer, Samir Patel (samir.patel@finovate.com), to join the deep-dive so he can validate the network/KMS requirements.

If you have limited earlier availability, share what you can and I’ll surface it internally.

Thanks,
Emma 
Emma Lawson
Head of Product | Finovate Systems
emma.lawson@finovate.com

Emma —

Totally understand. We want to keep momentum so Marissa and I carved out two earlier, tighter options to see if either works for your team before we move into May. If neither of these fit, we'll open up May 3–5 as you requested.

Alternative tight options (please confirm within 24 hours if possible):
• Mon 26 Apr, 11:00–11:30 AM PT — https://cal.redwood.com/s/26Apr-11am
• Tue 27 Apr, 09:00–09:30 AM PT — https://cal.redwood.com/s/27Apr-09am

We’ll include a solutions engineer for the demo and an infra engineer on standby; Marissa will run the walkthrough. If Samir can join, that would be ideal — cc’ing him here to make the connection.

Quick ask: If you confirm the earlier slot, please (1) add Samir to the calendar invite and (2) indicate any specific KMS/PKI docs he wants reviewed ahead of time. I attached the initial MVP requirements matrix; it helps narrow the discussion.

If we don’t hear back in 24 hours we’ll open those slots to other conversations.

Thanks — Rafael
Attachment: MVP_requirements.xlsx
